messages:
ash: Quick repro I hit today: SDK import flips to CJS during Vite optimizeDeps and edge SSR build fails with `ReferenceError: require is not defined`. App is ESM (type:module) and imports `import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference-js'`.

rachel: Can you paste package.json exports and how you built dist?

ash: Exports: `{
  ".": { "import": "./dist/index.mjs", "require": "./dist/index.cjs" }
}`. Build uses rollup -> produces index.mjs but rollup output had `interop` helpers.

diego: Vite/esbuild will prebundle CJS if it sees require in dependency graph. Two fast workarounds: 1) add `optimizeDeps.include: ['@redwood/inference-js']` 2) alias to the .mjs file in vite.config.

ash: Alias fixed dev only. The SSR build (rollup/webpack) still emits CJS wrappers. Root cause seems to be ambiguous entrypoints + interop wrappers injected by our build.

rachel: Short-term: publish tiny top-level `index.mjs` that re-exports dist/index.mjs and make `exports.import` point to it. Also enable `declarationMap` so TS server resolves back to source.

build-bot: Published canary @redwood/inference-js@0.6.1-canary.ash.

diego: Long term: make ESM the canonical entry for modern targets, ensure rollup output.interop=false for ESM builds, and add bundler smoke tests (vite optimizeDeps + ssr rollup + webpack webworker).

ash: I'll open a PR with the index.mjs shim + CI smoke test and link the repro. Short thread but wanted to capture the quick mitigation. :thumbsup:
